post.caption:
Your gut lining is replaced within a week, your skin in about a month, a red blood cell lasts around four months, and your skeleton turns over roughly every ten years. A few things stay for life, including some brain neurons and the lens of your eye. Which means what stays continuous about you is not the material. It is the pattern the material keeps rebuilding.
